_: Per-metric normalizers for the LoGo reward on this model: R = sum over terms of sign * weight * (value - mu) / sigma. mu cancels in the per-scene advantage, so sigma is what sets a term's effective weight -- it is the WITHIN-SCENE spread (across the K rollouts of one scene), measured on this model. A sigma from another model or another rollout length silently reweights the term. NFT_NORM_OVERRIDE overrides entries at runtime; NFT_NORM_FILE points elsewhere.

vggt_mse.what: RGB reprojection error (squared) of the fused VGGT-Omega cloud. Lower is better.

vggt_depth_mae.what: Depth reprojection error (absolute) over covered, unoccluded pixels. Lower is better.

hpsv3_vid.what: Mean HPSv3 over keyframes of the rollout clip. Higher is better.

rpe_rot.what: Relative pose error, rotation, in degrees. Lower is better.

rpe_trans.what: Relative pose error, translation, normalized by reference path length. Lower is better.
